title: Go Tool Catalog
description: The canonical Go tool catalog (catalog/tools.json) of the go-quality-authority home: the admitted Go tools consumed as tool directives of the tenant tooling modules. The catalog admission is the single admission surface for every Go tool of a tenant. The schema is owned and shipped by the go-quality-authority home, strictly decoded, and proven by the contract-test set; the catalog references it by identity (asserted, never dereferenced).

$schema.description: The canonical identity reference of this schema — asserted by identity, never dereferenced.

tools.description: The admitted Go tools; the admission key is the tool name.

name.description: The kebab-case tool name — the admission key.

module.description: The Go module path that carries the tool.

package.description: The Go package path of the tool's main package — the tool-directive target.

purpose.description: The precise purpose of the tool in the gate set.
